rule.title: An HSA funding distribution the taxpayer elects to exclude is not taxable

when_missing.because: A distribution was kept unless a preparer says it was rolled over or was an HSA funding distribution

citation.wording: If the total amount distributed is an HFD and you elect to exclude it from income

rule.open_point: The sentence continues 'enter -0- on line 4b'. An HFD may be made once in a lifetime and is limited to the HSA contribution limit; whether it qualified is the preparer's answer.
